text:
Dai: Quick update — ran a saturation sweep for Mixtral MoE top-k routing in stage. When top_k >= 4 and router_temp = 1.2 we see a ~30% throughput drop and KV cache pressure spikes. Attaching perf summary + small traces. Anyone seen this pattern?
Alice: Can you paste the p50/p95 and kernel breakdown?
Dai: Sure, high-level snapshot from the run:
```
run_config: top_k=4 router_temp=1.2 experts=64 expert_parallelism=2 fuse_kernels=false
p50=45ms p95=220ms tokens/s=18k   # baseline top_k=1 gave p95=120ms tokens/s=28k
kernel_pct: matmul=42% collect_kv=18% router_softmax=22% memcpy=10% other=8%
expert_cache_evicted=120000 spill_to_host=true(18%)
```
Ben: Router_softmax at 22% stands out. Did you try the fused topk/softmax kernels? Those cut softmax time a lot in prior runs. Also check batching window — small windows can increase scheduling overhead.
Dai: Tried fuse_kernels=true briefly; softmax dropped to ~9% but memcpy jumped up. End-to-end p95 improved from 220ms to 185ms. Also toggled continuous_batching window=5ms -> throughput up but tail got worse.
Carla: KV cache pressure: are we hitting eviction thresholds or spilling to host memory? The "spill_to_host" is worrying for tail. Can you paste eviction log lines?
Dai: Log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-10T21:12:03Z] expert_cache_evicted=120000 threshold=0.8 per_gpu_eviction=30000
[2026-03-10T21:12:04Z] host_spill=true freed_gpu_mem=2.4GB latency_penalty_ms=12
[2026-03-10T21:12:04Z] router_topk=4 per_request_experts=3 routing_skips=1.2%
```
Emma: We've seen similar when expert_parallelism > 1 per GPU. More parallelism increases shadow copies and cache duplication -> more eviction. Try expert_parallelism=1 or reduce experts per GPU. Also check RoPE scaling impact on attention buffers — can bump memory.
Ben: Could this be a regression from the recent kernel selector changes? @infra-bot can you show the last deploys that touched the matmul/softmax kernel selection flags?
infra-bot: Deploy log: 2026-02-27T03:12:00Z by infra-eng (commit abc123) changed kernel_selector: enable_auto_gemm=true, prefer_fused_softmax=false. 2026-03-02T18:45:22Z by perf-team (commit def456) added heuristic: choose_fused_topk_if_percentile(0.6).
Alice: I can queue a pprof + nvprof capture overnight to get GPU timeline traces. Also want to run a reduced-topk baseline: top_k=2 vs 4 with fuse_kernels toggled.
Dai: Plan for tonight: 1) A/B top_k=2 vs top_k=4 2) enable fuse_kernels + pinned_alloc=true to see memcpy improvements 3) set expert_parallelism=1 4) set kv_eviction_threshold=0.75 and histogram per-expert load. Will push config and run for 6 hours, post results. Any objections?
Carla: :thumbsup: please include per-expert load histogram and per-gpu eviction counts. That will tell if a few experts are hot.
Ben: Also test router_temp=0.8 and the softmax-scaling trick (divide logits by sqrt(k)) — that reduced top-k softmax blowup in a previous model.
Emma: If helpful, quick runner script:
```
# ab test runner
./perf_runner --model mixtral-moe \\
  --top_k 2,4 --router_temp 0.8,1.2 --fuse_kernels true,false \\
  --expert_parallelism 1 --pinned_alloc true --kv_eviction=0.75 \\
  --metrics_out /tmp/mixtral_ab.json --duration 6h
```
Dai: Thanks — I'll run this tonight and dump traces + flamegraphs to the perf dashboard (link: https://perf.rw/infer/mixtral/moe/topk-1764456789). Will ping results tomorrow morning and assign follow-ups. tagging @Carla @Ben @Alice @Emma :eyes:
